But that prior claim counts nonnegative-prefix Dyck words, not all balanced bridges: the identity as a formal transform alone does not establish that B enumerates the complete balanced-word index distribution. The new signed-arch constant-term proof supplies that separate combinatorial meaning, and uniform coefficient asymptotics supply conditional centering corrections. The maximal-index coefficient 2^n is already known and is not claimed novel.

value.rationale: Strictly balanced strings are a motivated reconstruction/subsequence-spectra class in the 2019 primary literature.
